{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the trial data
data = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Filter for patients with SEVERE disease
severe_patients = data[data['severity'] == 'severe']

# Identify and exclude sentinel value -999.0
valid_severe_biomarkers = severe_patients[severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'] != -999.0]['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute the mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinel values)
mean_biomarker_severe_valid = valid_severe_biomarkers.mean()

# Print the result
print(f"Mean baseline biomarker value for severe patients (excluding sentinel values): {mean_biomarker_severe_valid}")"}
